baseline: Previously accepted RC ECO (C2=220nF; R2=(26.5,20)mm), not the earlier 100nF/pre-move version

testpoint.schematic_placement: Automatic near C2 on the root sheet; no manual coordinates/rotation are requested
testpoint.unconnected_definition: TP1.1 is an isolated singleton with a no-connect marker; native auto-generated unconnected net name is not a tenth intended named net

protected: All original component references/UUID relationships/footprints/pad numbers/values/positions/rotations/layers
All channel 1,3,4 logical pin maps and copper geometry/UUIDs
Original GND tracks/vias and zone definitions; fills separately rechecked
Original board outline geometry; rule severities and ignored checks

rules.rename_assignment_policy: Retain numeric rules and existing-net assignments. If rename does not propagate assignment, explicitly apply the existing RC4 values to OUT2_SENSE; an unused old-name assignment may remain. Do not relax any rule.

requirements.schema_metadata: Top-level wrapper extra keys are caller metadata, not edit operations; named text fields retain existing semantics.

pcb_strategy.main: Rename-only delivery board; protect original layout/copper. During temporary testpoint lifetime retain this board. After schematic TP deletion, sync main again and compare the final intended graph.
pcb_strategy.testpoint_branch: Independent explicit PCB/project copy of the renamed board. Validate real addition, placement, pad/net sync, selected-net routing and disconnection here. Route/width/refill only the declared affected net/zones, with native checks.
pcb_strategy.deletion_boundary: Existing project sync preserves unmatched PCB footprints and has no public remove policy. TP deletion on this branch must be reported unsupported/not applied to PCB; do not confirm preservation as deletion or hand-edit. Preserve this unfinished branch as evidence. This predeclared gap does not redefine the final main-board requirement.

stages: S0 unchanged baseline fresh native read and images
S1 OUT2 -> OUT2_SENSE, main PCB sync and effective-rule retention
S2 add TP1 with pin1 NC; branch PCB add and position readback
S3 connect TP1.1 to OUT2_SENSE; value MONITOR_OUT2; branch sync and real copper connectivity
S4 disconnect TP1.1 with NC; branch sync and selected-net copper repair; no original net accidentally shorted
S5 remove TP1 in schematic; main PCB final sync; branch deletion explicitly unsupported
acceptance: Full pin membership and identities at each stage, fresh native saved-file XML/PCB reads, native ERC where applicable; native DRC for completed PCB stages. Full images and explicit current snapshot-bound visual verdict. No design electrical/ampacity/supplier sign-off.

revision_reason.only_requirement_change: TP1 placement choice (55,32) mm, away from the existing route field; all original pin intent, numeric rules, original-object protection, naming and operation sequence unchanged
